title: Cryptoassets Standard and Other Miscellaneous Amendments: Consultation on Return Templates
summary: On 13 June 2025, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) published a consultation titled 'Cryptoassets standard and other miscellaneous amendments: consultation on return templates,' with accompanying explanatory notes covering Part IIIc of banking return MA(BS)3. HKMA's numbered 'MA' returns are the standardised periodic reports that Authorized Institutions file with HKMA for prudential-supervision purposes; consulting on a return template means inviting those institutions to comment on a proposed new or amended version of the form, and of its accompanying explanatory notes, before HKMA finalises it. As its own title states, the amendments open for comment here are described as implementing a 'cryptoassets standard' for this return, together with other, unspecified miscellaneous changes to the same template.
why_it_matters: This consultation is how HKMA proposes to change the standardised prudential reports its supervised banks must file, specifically to reflect their exposure to cryptoassets, before any such change is finalised. For a newcomer, it is a sign that Hong Kong's banking regulator is extending its routine prudential-reporting machinery, not just its licensing rules, to cover cryptoassets.
